Review my bank statements and credit card transactions weekly across all my accounts

Track my net worth monthly (bank balances, investments, assets, debts)

Degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration (MUST HAVE)

Interest in personal finance and wealth building

Full-time (30 to 40 HRs | Work-from-home | US Pacific Time hours

About the role

A growing West Coast US independent insurance agency has an opening for an experienced Commercial Lines Property & Casualty service representative. This is a varied role — many of the functions are not repetitive — supporting the day-to-day servicing of a commercial book. The ideal candidate is ready to learn in an unstructured, fast-moving environment and can move quickly to complete tasks with minimal hand-holding. Training will be provided.

This is a long-term position for someone who wants to build a career, not a short-term gig. We invest in people who stick.

Schedule & setup

• Full-time, Monday–Friday, Start time 900 AM Pacific — this is a night-shift role in the Philippines.

• 100% work-from-home.

• Paid U.S. holidays and vacation time benefits.

• Candidates must provide their own up-to-date computer, headset, and stable workspace.

• This is a work-from-home role using your own PC and equipment; we do not provide hardware.

• Minimum 50 Mbps download, hardwired into your modem (no satellite, no shared mobile data).

• Reliable backup power/internet strongly preferred.

What you'll do

• Commercial Lines quoting and rating support.

• Prepare and issue Certificates of Insurance and process Additional Insured / endorsement requests accurately.

• Conduct renewal reviews and keep renewal workflows on track.

• Process commercial policy endorsements, audits, and cancellations.

• Complete and assemble ACORD applications and carrier supplemental applications.

• Order, review, and summarize loss runs and MVRs.

• Maintain clean, accurate data in our agency management system and document all activity.

• Follow up with carriers, wholesalers, and clients on outstanding items.

Required (we will screen hard on these)

• Minimum 4 years of work experience in Commercial Insurance supporting a US agency, MGA, wholesaler, or carrier. Personal-lines-only or healthcare/medical-VA backgrounds are not a fit for this role.

• Commercial Lines quoting, certificate (cert) work, and renewal review experience are absolutely necessary — these will be verified once a successful candidate is identified and offered the position.

• Familiarity with NowCerts/Momentum Agency Management Systems is huge plus. Online training will be provided for those who are well-versed in other AMS.

• Direct, practical familiarity with ACORD forms, Certificates of Insurance, and Additional Insured endorsements.

• Excellent written and spoken English — you'll communicate directly with US carriers and clients.

• Ability to learn in an unstructured environment, prioritize, and move quickly without being chased.

• Familiarity with Group Health Insurance enrollment and servicing process.

• Familiarity with Personal Lines. Home coverage only. Auto insurance is not a significant part of our book.

Preferred (nice to have, not required)

• Direct customer contact experience.

• Experience with NowCerts specifically.

• Familiarity with commercial classes such as contractors, mixed-use/ground-up construction, habitational, restaurants, or professional offices.

• Exposure to E&S / surplus lines and online placement platforms.

• Comfort building or maintaining simple Excel trackers and workbooks.



How to apply (please read carefully)

To apply, send the following. Applications that skip any step will not be reviewed:

1. Start your message with the word "Rosewood" so we know you read this posting in full.

2. A short paragraph describing the commercial lines work you've personally done — name the specific tasks (e.g., "quoted commercial accounts," "issued COIs," "processed endorsements in [AMS]," "handled renewal reviews").

3. Which agency management system(s) you've used, and for how long.

4. Answer this in 2–3 sentences: A client needs a Certificate of Insurance naming their landlord as Additional Insured on their General Liability. Walk me through, at a high level, the steps you'd take to handle that request.

5. Your internet speed (run a speed test and tell us the download number) and your home setup.

Include your phone number for quick contact.

title: Creative Strategist for Ecom Ads / UGC Video Ads
description:
We are looking for a Creative Strategist to help us create high-performing video ad concepts for ecommerce brands.



Please send your portfolio at the start of your application. Also include how much ad spend your creatives have been used on and what ROAS/performance results your ads have achieved in the past.



This role will start part-time and can grow into a full-time position for the right person.



Your main job will be to research winning ads, study competitors, come up with new angles, write hooks/scripts, and create clear briefs for video editors and UGC creators.



Responsibilities:



* Research winning ads on Meta, TikTok, Google, and competitor brands

* Find strong hooks, angles, and video concepts

* Write creative briefs for editors and content creators

* Break down why certain ads are working

* Organize ideas into clear batches for our editors

* Help improve existing ads by finding better hooks, pacing, and messaging

* Stay updated on ecommerce ad trends



You are a good fit if:



* You understand direct response marketing

* You can write strong hooks and ad angles

* You are creative but also organized

* You can explain your ideas clearly

* You have experience with ecommerce, supplements, beauty, skincare, health, or DTC brands

* You are comfortable using tools like
 Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, Google Drive, Notion/Sheets, and ChatGPT



Bonus if you have experience with:



* UGC ads

* Supplement or beauty brands

* Meta ads

* TikTok ads

* Writing scripts for short-form video ads

* Managing creative batches for editors



This is not just a basic VA role. We are looking for someone who can think strategically, bring new ideas, and help us create ads that actually sell.



To apply, please answer these questions:



1. Put the phrase “chicken or apple” at the top of your application so I know you read this.

2. Please send your portfolio or examples of past creative work.

3. What experience do you have with ecommerce ads or creative strategy?

4. How much ad spend have your creatives been used on?

5. What ROAS or performance results have your ads achieved in the past?

6. Send 2–3 examples of ad concepts, scripts, or briefs you have worked on.

7. What makes a good hook for a video ad?

8. Find one ecommerce ad you think is strong and explain why it works.



We are looking for someone long-term. You will start part-time, and if the work is strong, this can become a full-time position.

We're a premium video production company in Australia. We've spent years building a system that delivers world-class work, on time, every time.

Over 1,000 projects and multiple national awards. We make high-end videos for enterprise brands, government, and major industry associations. You'll be working with serious, enterprise-level clients who expect everything to be perfect.

title: QA Manager
description:
WE’RE HIRING! JOIN OUR TEAM!



Position: QA Manager

Company: Baton (
)

Location: 100% Remote (WFH)

Work Hours: Mountain Standard Time

Rate/Salary: $8-10 per hour



About the Role



Baton is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented QA Manager to oversee quality assurance, compliance, buyer performance, and traffic quality across our call marketplace.



This role is responsible for monitoring call quality, publisher compliance, buyer performance, refund trends, and operational risks to ensure the marketplace maintains high standards of quality and accountability. The QA Manager will proactively identify issues, investigate root causes, and work cross-functionally with Publisher Management, Client Success, Operations, Sales, and Leadership to improve conversion outcomes, reduce preventable credits, and strengthen partner performance.



This is a highly visible role that combines quality assurance, compliance oversight, reporting, operational analysis, and process improvement.



Key Responsibilities



Credit & Refund Oversight

- Monitor credit and refund trends by buyer, campaign, publisher, sub-ID, and category.

- Identify recurring fail reasons, unusual approval rates, and emerging patterns.

- Investigate whether issues originate from traffic quality or buyer-side operational failures.

- Flag buyers with excessive refund requests or abnormal credit behavior.

- Develop recurring reports highlighting refund drivers and trends.

- Recommend corrective actions including routing adjustments, bid changes, publisher feedback, buyer coaching, and traffic filtering improvements.



Call Quality Assurance

- Review call recordings, transcripts, and call outcomes on a daily and weekly basis.

- Evaluate transfer quality, buyer call handling, and overall caller experience.

- Review AI-assisted call interactions where applicable.

- Identify fraud, coached callers, low-intent leads, wrong-service inquiries, compliance concerns, and other quality issues.

- Maintain a library of common quality issues, examples, and training materials.



Buyer Performance Monitoring

- Track buyer answer rates, connection rates, call handling effectiveness, and responsiveness.

- Identify buyers missing calls, creating poor caller experiences, or generating avoidable credits.

- Analyze operational issues impacting conversion performance.

- Surface trends by buyer, region, and campaign.

- Escalate performance concerns to Sales, Client Success, Operations, and Leadership teams.

- Support initiatives that improve buyer accountability and service levels.



Compliance Management

- Maintain publisher compliance records and documentation.

- Ensure required certifications, disclosures, traffic source information, and supporting materials are current and complete.

- Monitor renewal and recertification requirements.

- Review landing pages, disclaimers, and traffic source declarations for compliance.

- Investigate TCPA-related concerns and other compliance alerts.

- Escalate high-risk publishers or traffic sources when necessary.

- Maintain audit-ready compliance documentation.



Alert Monitoring & Investigation

- Monitor alerts related to fraud, TCPA risk, answer-rate issues, abnormal call behavior, and - refund spikes.

- Conduct root cause investigations and document findings.

- Recommend and track corrective actions.

- Collaborate with internal stakeholders to resolve recurring issues.



Reporting & Trend Analysis

- Develop and maintain QA scorecards and performance dashboards.

- Create recurring reports for leadership on:

- Traffic quality

- Buyer performance

- Refund trends

- Compliance risk

- Operational performance

- Translate data into actionable recommendations.

- Measure the effectiveness of implemented solutions over time.



SOP Ownership & Process Improvement

- Create, document, and maintain standard operating procedures for:

- Call reviews

- Compliance reviews

- Refund investigations

- Escalation management

- Quality assurance processes

- Standardize QA definitions, audit criteria, and review methodologies.

- Improve workflows between QA, Publisher Management, Sales, Client Success, and Operations.

- Assist with training and coaching around recurring quality and compliance issues.



Escalation Management

- Serve as the primary point of contact for quality and compliance escalations.

- Route issues to the appropriate teams and stakeholders.

- Track investigations through resolution.

- Identify systemic issues and implement long-term solutions.



Additional Responsibilities

- Audit call disposition accuracy and consistency.

- Review category mapping and call routing logic.

- Monitor buyer coverage failures and no-answer trends.

- Support dispute resolution through call reviews and documentation.

- Maintain training examples of approved versus non-approved traffic.

- Partner with Data and Engineering teams to improve dashboards, alerts, and reporting.

- Help establish thresholds for buyer warnings, pauses, and escalations.



Qualifications



Required

- 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, Compliance, Operations, Call Center Management, - Lead Generation, Performance Marketing, or a related field.

- Strong analytical and investigative skills.

- Experience reviewing call recordings, transcripts, and performance data.

- Ability to identify trends and root causes across large datasets.

- Strong reporting and dashboard experience.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.

- Experience creating SOPs, documentation, and process improvements.



Preferred

- Experience in pay-per-call, lead generation, affiliate marketing, or call marketplaces.

- Familiarity with TCPA compliance and call tracking platforms.

- Experience working with publisher networks, buyers, and performance marketing ecosystems.

- Experience with AI-driven call handling or conversational AI platforms.

- Experience using CRM, BI, and reporting tools.



Success Metrics (KPIs)

- Accurate and timely delivery of credit and refund trend reporting.

- Percentage of active publishers reviewed monthly.

- Percentage of high-risk buyers audited monthly.

- Time to investigate and escalate quality concerns.

- Reduction in preventable credits and refunds.

- Reduction in buyer-side answer rate and connectivity issues.

- Reduction in invalid, misrouted, or wrong-category calls.

- Compliance documentation completion and audit readiness.

- Alert investigation and resolution rates.

- QA audit volume, quality, and turnaround time.



What Success Looks Like



The successful QA Manager will create visibility into marketplace quality, identify risks before they become costly problems, improve buyer and publisher accountability, strengthen compliance standards, and help Baton maximize revenue by reducing preventable credits and operational inefficiencies.

title: News Writer / Journalist
description:
Title:  News Writer / Journalist

Location:  Remote – Philippines

Hours:  Shift options: UK, North American, or Australian market hours

Reporting to:  Managing Editor / News Desk Lead

Contract Type:  Contractor



About Proactive

Proactive is a global multimedia organisation and the leading provider of real-time AI-integrated media, analytics and market data tools to issuers globally. Working with over 1,800 clients across the UK, US, Canada and Australia, Proactive delivers breaking news, video interviews, podcasts, investor forums, sponsored research and behavioural marketing campaigns that drive stakeholder awareness and engagement.

Through our proprietary NewsifAI™ platform and SaaS data tools, we are building the world’s most advanced AI-enabled financial news desk – combining speed, accuracy and editorial quality at scale.



Position Summary

Proactive is building a new global AI-enabled news desk and we are looking for financially literate reporters who can write fast, think clearly and work confidently alongside AI production tools. You will cover breaking news on UK, North American and ASX-listed companies, with a focus on junior resources, biotech, energy and small-cap growth stocks. You understand why company news moves share prices – and you can explain it to investors clearly and quickly.



Principal Accountabilities / Responsibilities

Reporting to the Managing Editor, the News Writer / Journalist will:

- Write fast, accurate and engaging news articles covering UK, North American and ASX-listed public companies

- Utilise Proactive’s proprietary NewsifAI™ tools and other AI production platforms to enhance speed and output quality

- Monitor RNS, newswire and exchange announcements across global markets during assigned shift hours

- Identify and communicate why company news moves share prices, with a focus on junior resources, biotech, energy and small-cap growth stocks

- Ensure all content meets Proactive editorial standards for accuracy, clarity and SEO performance

- Maintain strong social media literacy, supporting distribution of content across digital channels

- Meet daily output targets and deadlines in a fast-paced, remote newsroom environment



Person Specification – Skills and Experience Required

- 2+ years of reporting experience covering public companies or financial markets (or a journalism degree for entry-level applicants)

- Familiarity with AI tools including large language models (LLMs) and AI-assisted writing platforms

- Strong written English – fast, clear and investor-focused

- Social media literacy and understanding of digital content distribution

- SEO awareness and understanding of how to optimise financial news content

- Knowledge of the resources sector (mining, energy, metals) is a significant advantage

- Ability to work independently in a remote environment across time zones



Work Environment – What We Offer

- A front-row seat at the intersection of financial journalism and AI – shaping how news is made

- Remote, flexible working with shifts aligned to your chosen market (UK, North America or Australia)

- The opportunity to work with one of the best-known names in global financial media, trusted by over 1,800 listed companies

- Access to Proactive’s proprietary AI newsroom tools and technology stack

- A collaborative, fast-moving global team environment



How to Apply

If you are fast, accurate and curious about where AI-assisted journalism is heading, we want to hear from you.

Send your CV and two recent clips to: 

Please include your contact details, availability and the market shift (UK / North America / Australia) you are applying for. Only successful candidates will be contacted.

About PRD Real Estate Bendigo

PRD Real Estate Bendigo is one of Central Victoria's most recognised real estate agencies, helping buyers, sellers, and investors across the Bendigo region. We take pride in presenting properties at their absolute best — and great photography and video is a big part of how we do that.



We're a team that works hard, moves fast, and cares about quality. If you're someone who takes pride in their craft and can deliver consistently to a deadline, you'll fit right in.



About the Role

We're looking for a talented Video and Photo Editor who understands the real estate space. Property content has its own rhythm with tight turnarounds, high volume, and a consistent visual standard that needs to be maintained across every single listing. You'll be working closely with our in-house media team, and you'll also get the opportunity to flex your creative muscles on social media content, so this isn't just a production-line role.



This is a permanent full-time position with a standard weekly wage. You'll be expected to attend a weekly work in progress meeting with the team, so availability during business hours is important.



Responsibilities

PREFERRED

title: Content Writer
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a knowledgeable, detail-oriented Freelance SEO Content Writer to produce a high-quality, publishable buying guide article on a core horology topic: "Best Automatic Dive Watches Under £250." .

This is not a project for generic, AI-generated, or keyword-stuffed SEO copy . We are looking for an engaging, editorial-style writer who can speak with accessible authority —someone who can write a piece that feels credible to a seasoned watch enthusiast but remains welcoming and easy to digest for someone buying their very first automatic timepiece .

We have a distinct Tone of Voice and a fully fleshed-out SEO Content Brief (both attached to this post) to guide your writing style and structure.

Key Deliverables

You will be expected to provide a complete, publication-ready package containing :

The Full Finished Article: A well-structured, comprehensive guide featuring a clear introduction, individual watch breakdowns, strategic buying advice, a conclusion, and relevant FAQs .

Keyword Research & Metadata: Documentation of the search terms considered, search intent mapping, and a suggested SEO title, meta description, and clean URL slug .

A Specification Comparison Table: A clean layout format allowing readers to quickly contrast key technical data points across your chosen watches .

Asset & Styling Recommendations: Ideas for a hero image, lifestyle shots, product imagery, and SEO-friendly alt text, alongside natural internal and external linking suggestions .

Content Scope & Structure

The article must strike a balance between well-known heritage brands and high-value alternatives :

Brands to Cover: A curated mix including names like Seiko, Orient, Citizen, Invicta, Addiesdive, Steeldive, San Martin, Pagani Design, or any others you feel genuinely earn a spot .

The "Specification Rule": You must follow our brand rule—never leave a technical specification hanging. Every spec listed (e.g., a 38mm case size, sapphire crystal, or 200m water resistance) must instantly be followed by an explanation of its real-world meaning and value to the wearer .

Core Concepts: The text needs to unpack what makes an automatic dive watch unique at this specific under-£250 price bracket, highlighting both its core structural strengths and honest compromises .

Tone of Voice Expectations

Our brand identity positions itself as a "retailer with taste, knowledge, and a clear point of view." You must strictly adhere to our core tone principles:

Clear Before Clever: Get straight to the point and explain concepts clearly before layering in fine technical details .

Editorial, but Useful: Every section must actively answer real customer questions (e.g., What does water resistance actually mean in daily use? Why does this model deserve a closer look?) .

Knowledgeable, Not Intimidating: Your writing must respect collectors while thoroughly encouraging beginners .

Opinionated, Not Arrogant: Have a definitive point of view on watch proportions, wearability, and design choices without sounding snobby or dismissive .

Commercial, Not Pushy: Completely avoid empty urgency or "bargain-bin" discount language .

Candidate Requirements

Proven Experience: A strong background in SEO content writing with a portfolio that showcases engaging, editorial-style long-form guides .

Horology Knowledge: A genuine understanding of watches, mechanical movements, and standard diver specifications is highly preferred .

SEO Competency: Ability to naturally weave target keywords into headings and body text without creating robotic or over-stuffed copy .

title: Filipino Performance Marketing Manager for Ride-Sharing App (Full-Time, Cebu Launch)
description:
We are launching CashRide, a new ride-sharing app, in Cebu and we need 

an experienced Filipino performance marketing manager to OWN our entire 

paid acquisition and growth marketing function.



You will earn $200 to $300 USD per week ($800 to $1,200 USD per month) 

base salary based on experience, paid every Friday via Wise or PayPal. 

This is a senior, full-time, long-term role.



If you crush this Cebu launch, we will scale to other Philippine cities 

and your scope and base salary will grow with the platform. Annual 

salary reviews tied to results.



HOW I MANAGE (READ THIS FIRST)



I do not do video calls, daily standups, or Slack micromanagement.

Communication is
 and async messaging only.

You manage your time and run your function independently.

You are evaluated on numbers, not effort or hours logged.



This means you need to be a senior, self-directed operator who works 

from clear briefs and reports in clear numbers. If you need daily 

coaching, this is not the role for you. If you thrive with autonomy 

and want to be judged purely on results, you will love this role.



Performance review happens every 30 days based on numbers. Strong 

results = raises and expanded scope. Weak results = exit after one 

warning. Simple.



WHY FILIPINO ONLY

We specifically want a Filipino marketer because the Philippines market 

has unique consumer behavior, language nuances (Cebuano, Tagalog, 

Taglish, English), cash culture, and seasonal spending patterns 

(15th and 30th paydays, fiesta season) that only someone from the 

Philippines truly understands.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



Paid Advertising (50% of role)

- Build our entire Meta Ads Manager structure from scratch

- Set up Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and event tracking

- Run driver acquisition campaigns (Cebu males 20-50, secondary income)

- Run rider acquisition campaigns once we have 20+ active drivers

- Expand to TikTok Ads, Google Ads, YouTube Ads as we scale



Ad Creative (20% of role)

- Write all ad copy in English, Cebuano, Tagalog, or Taglish as needed

- Brief or create video and static ad creative

- A/B test relentlessly



Organic Social and Community (15% of role)

- Manage CashRide's
 Page, Instagram, TikTok

- Post 3-5x per week

- Build Cebu community presence

- Identify and reach out to micro-influencers



Growth Strategy and Analytics (15% of role)

- Daily monitoring of ad accounts and analytics

- Weekly written performance report to me (numbers only, no fluff)

- Monthly strategy memo with next-month plan

- Recommend new channels, partnerships, and growth tactics



REQUIRED

- Filipino, based in the Philippines (anywhere - Cebu, Manila, anywhere)

- 5+ years of paid advertising experience

- Direct experience running ads for at least one of: ride-share, food 

  delivery, marketplace, e-commerce, or local services in the 

  Philippines market

- Strong written English communication

- Native Tagalog or Cebuano (Cebuano strongly preferred since our 

  launch market is Cebu)

- Can show portfolio with actual ad account screenshots, CPC, conversion 

  data, and case studies

- Senior operator who works independently from briefs - no handholding 

  required



PREFERRED (NOT REQUIRED)

- Experience launching products from zero in the Philippines

- TikTok Ads, Google Ads, YouTube Ads expertise

- Video editing skills for fast creative iteration

- Worked with Stripe, Capacitor, or Firebase-based products

- Influencer outreach experience



COMPENSATION SUMMARY

- $200 to $300 USD/week guaranteed base salary ($800 to $1,200/month, 

  paid every Friday via Wise or PayPal)

- Ad spend budget is separate and funded by me directly through Meta

- 30-day performance reviews with raise potential

- Annual salary reviews tied to platform growth



WORKING HOURS

- 40 hours per week, fully flexible schedule

- No required meetings, no required hours, no time tracking

- One weekly written report due every Monday by noon Philippine Time



ACCOUNTABILITY

- You are evaluated on numbers only, not effort or hours

- Key metrics: CPA per driver, CPA per rider, ROAS, platform revenue 

  growth from paid traffic

- 30-day, 60-day, 90-day performance reviews

- Strong results = raises and expanded scope. Weak results = exit 

  after one warning.



HOW TO APPLY

Please send:

1. A short voice or video recording (1-2 minutes) introducing yourself 

   in English

2. Your portfolio with at least 2-3 case studies showing actual ad 

   account screenshots, spend, CPC, conversion rates, and ROAS

3. A written 90-day plan for how you would launch CashRide in Cebu 

   from zero (this is the most important part - I want to see how 

   you think strategically about a cold launch)

4. Your current/recent full-time or retainer rates

5. Your earliest start date and current client load



Applications without ALL 5 items will be ignored. Especially missing 

the 90-day plan - that is non-negotiable.



I will reply to every serious application within 48 hours.



Looking forward to building this with the right person.



David Protaziuk

Founder, CashRide

title: LinkedIn Outreach + Executive Assistant (AI-Forward, Long-Term Growth Role)

I run a boutique executive search firm in the US. I am looking for ONE sharp, reliable, English-fluent assistant to become my right hand. This starts part-time and is built to grow into a full-time, long-term role for the right person. I invest in people who want to grow with me.

LinkedIn business development (the main job). You are not closing deals. You are opening doors and starting friendly conversations. The 
nt someone is interested, you hand the conversation to me.

Conversation management. Reply to messages, keep threads warm, stay organized, and never let a good lead go cold. Strong written English and a genuinely warm, human tone are essential.

Personal and executive admin. Scheduling, appointment booking (including doctor and personal appointments), ordering supplies, research, data entry, light calendar and inbox support, and other tasks that free up my time.

title: ComfyUI / Flux Image Generation Engineer — Self-Hosted Art Pipeline
description:
ComfyUI / Flux Image Generation Engineer — Self-Hosted Cover Art Pipeline (Contract)

About us



We're a US-based multifaceted media company with a high-volume content catalog. We build lean, we work async, and we treat strong contractors as long-term partners with direct access — no unnecessary meetings, no agency layers. We already run our own self-hosted AI infrastructure on RunPod, and this role extends that into image generation.

The problem we're solving



Hosted image tools don't fit our needs. One renders beautiful art but blocks certain compositions we legitimately require; another allows them but produces a duller aesthetic. We want to stop renting other people's policies and aesthetics and instead own a self-hosted ComfyUI + Flux pipeline that gives us full creative control, consistent characters across a series, and our exact house style — at a marginal cost per image far below hosted APIs.

What you'll build



A production ComfyUI workflow on our RunPod GPU infrastructure for generating cover art and other commercial imagery

A trained style LoRA (or LoRA stack) that locks in our house aesthetic, so output looks like ours, not a generic base-model default

Character consistency across a series using Flux.2 multi-reference and/or IPAdapter

Inpainting and ControlNet passes for pose, composition, and fixing details (hands, wardrobe)

A batch pipeline driven by the ComfyUI API (workflow JSON via POST) so our operations team can generate at volume from a simple manifest/front end without ever touching the node graph

Clear documentation and a short handoff so our operations team can operate it day-to-day



Must-have skills



Demonstrated experience building non-trivial ComfyUI workflows (please link or screenshot real graphs you've built)

Hands-on with the Flux model family (Flux.2 Dev and Klein) in ComfyUI

LoRA training experience — you've trained your own, not just downloaded them

IPAdapter / ControlNet / inpainting for identity consistency and composition control

Deploying and running ComfyUI on cloud GPUs (RunPod ideal; Vast, Lambda, etc. fine)

Python, and comfort driving ComfyUI via its API for batch automation



Nice to have



Experience generating cover art, ad creative, or other commercial media imagery

LoRA training/publishing on Civitai

Upscaling and print-resolution finishing workflows

Familiarity with Firebase (our broader stack) if we wrap the pipeline in a simple internal UI



Screening questions (please answer in your application)



Link me to 2+ ComfyUI workflows you personally built, ideally with example output.

Have you trained your own LoRA? Briefly describe the dataset and what you were dialing in.

How would you keep the same character's face consistent across 8 covers in a series?

Have you deployed ComfyUI on RunPod or similar? Walk me through your setup.



Paid test task (for shortlisted candidates)



A small, paid task: deploy a basic Flux.2 workflow on a GPU we provide, and produce a short set of images of the same character in different scenes, generated via the ComfyUI API rather than the UI. We're evaluating consistency and whether the pipeline is genuinely API-driven.

Engagement & compensation



Project-based to start (the initial build), with an ongoing monthly retainer likely for maintenance, model updates, and workflow improvements as new Flux versions ship. Budget is in the $800–$1,500/month range for the right mid-level engineer, with the initial build scoped and paid as a project. We pay reliably and on time, and we keep good contractors for the long haul.



Responses can be made here indicating interest or by filling out the application at: https://podio.com/webforms/30763064/2614705



We look forward to working with you!

title: Senior Media Buyer - Meta, Google, Tiktok
description:
Senior Media Buyer

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time

Compensation: $12 / hour



About the Role



We’re looking for a senior media buyer who can confidently manage six-figure monthly ad spend across Meta and Google, with TikTok and other growth channels as a strong plus. But platform fluency is the floor here, not the bar.

This is not a “log in, check ROAS, adjust budgets, log off” role. We’re looking for someone who treats the ad account as one lever in a much bigger machine — someone who understands how creative, retention, product, inventory, merchandising, customer behavior, and operations all feed back into acquisition performance.



This person should be highly analytical, but also creative and commercially minded. You should be just as comfortable looking at Meta campaign structure as you are asking why a product page is not converting, why a bestseller is out of stock, why returning customer revenue is inflating ROAS, or why a creative angle is no longer resonating.



For a brand like ours, paid media is not only about scaling spend. It’s about understanding what is actually driving profitable growth. That means looking beyond platform-reported ROAS and using tools like Triple Whale, GA4, Shopify, and ad platform data together to understand the full picture.



If you’ve ever felt like a media buying role boxed you into “just optimize the account” when you could clearly see bigger opportunities in creative, funnel, product, retention, or offer strategy — this role is built for you.



Why This Role Is Different



Most media buying roles are siloed. You get an account, a budget, and a target, and you’re left to “make the numbers work” with limited visibility into anything upstream or downstream.



We’re explicitly looking for the opposite of that.



You’ll have direct access to and regular collaboration with the people who own creative, retention, product, merchandising, and operations. You’ll be expected to ask questions like:



“Is our ROAS being inflated by returning customers?”

“Are we scaling the right products based on margin, inventory, and customer demand?”

“Is this creative underperforming because of the hook, the product angle, or what happens after someone clicks?”

“Are we pushing spend into SKUs that are about to sell out?”

“Is our acquisition actually profitable when we look at new customer CAC, AMER, and contribution margin?”

“Are we over-discounting when scarcity, product storytelling, or drop energy would work better?”



This role is for someone who wants their media buying expertise to shape broader marketing strategy, not just execute inside someone else’s plan.



If you want to work on a brand where creative, product, customer psychology, and performance marketing all deeply intersect, we’d love to talk.



What You’ll Do



- Own paid media performance across Meta, Google, and TikTok, with bonus experience across platforms like Snap, Pinterest, Reddit, AppLovin, programmatic, or other emerging channels.

- Deep understanding of DTC performance metrics beyond platform ROAS, including MER, AMER, RMER, blended CAC, new customer CAC, returning customer revenue mix, LTV, AOV, contribution margin, and payback period.

nts.

description:

You will own the inbox completely. Every

Working Hours



Your working hours must overlap with 10am-5pm HST (4am-11am PH). We operate async-first, so outside of scheduled meetings and check-ins you have flexibility on how you structure your remaining hours. What matters is outcomes, not clock-watching.

Competitive, based on experience. Remote position.

mbers—how many projects or people have you managed and in what capacity (e.g., maintaining accountability, triaging requests)?

title: Creative Appointment Setter / Outbound Specialist
description:
We are a fast growing US based digital marketing agency and we are hiring a creative outbound specialist. This is not a cold dialing, copy paste setter job. We want someone who gets genuinely creative about how they reach the right people. If your first instinct when you really want to land someone is "how do I make them stop and pay attention," keep reading.



Learn more about us at 
 before you apply.



WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT



For the prospects we most want to win, we do not just send a message. We create a custom sample of our work and show them exactly what we can do for them. You find those prospects and craft the personalized approach. Our creative team produces the content. You are the outreach brain. We are the firepower behind you.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Research and build targeted prospect lists of brands and businesses we want to work with



Craft creative, personalized outreach across
, DM, LinkedIn, wherever the prospect actually is



Spot the high value prospects worth a custom content sample and coordinate with our creative team



Book qualified calls onto the founder's calendar



Track your outreach and results and keep improving



THE MAIN MISSION



From day one your focus is landing great clients for our agency. We work with standout, disruptive brands, and that is our bread and butter. Here is the catch: the brands worth landing get pitched constantly, so generic outreach gets ignored. This is exactly where you get creative. You find the brands we want, figure out how to actually reach the people who run them, and use standout, personalized outreach to get them on a call. Getting to these brands in a way no one else does is the heart of the role.



WHO WE WANT



Creative and resourceful, not a script reader



Writes clean, natural messages that sound human



Can research a prospect and find the real reason they would say yes



Organized, and tracks everything



Strong written English



Bonus: experience in B2B outreach, appointment setting, or SDR work



PAY AND STRUCTURE



This is a performance role: base plus commission, weighted toward commission, with uncapped upside. The better you are, the more you make. We pay well for someone very good. There is a clear path to full time and a higher base as you prove the model. We will talk specifics in the interview based on your experience.



SCHEDULE AND START



Part time and remote to start, around 20 hours per week, able to overlap a few hours with US Eastern time. Start immediately. Live outreach begins shortly after onboarding.



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully, this is part of the test)



1. Start your message with the word ATTENTION so we know you read the whole post.

2. Tell us about a time you got creative to get someone's attention. What did you do and what happened.

3. Pick one real brand you think we should land as a client. Find them online in ten minutes, tell us who they are and why they are a strong fit, and write the exact first message you would send the person who runs it.



Applications that skip step 3 will not be considered. We are hiring for the brain behind the outreach, so show us how you think.

title: Dental Insurance Coordinator& Revenue Cycle Coordinator (Remote)
description:
About Butterfly Dental Care



Butterfly Dental Care is a technology-driven, patient-focused dental practice committed to providing exceptional customer service and high-quality dentistry. We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and experienced Dental Insurance & Revenue Cycle Coordinator to join our team remotely.



This is a full-time position for someone with strong dental insurance knowledge and accounting/reconciliation experience.



## Position Overview



The Dental Insurance & Revenue Cycle Coordinator will be responsible for managing insurance claims, payment posting, insurance follow-up, daily deposit reconciliation, eligibility verification, and revenue tracking to ensure accurate financial reporting and timely collections.



This role requires excellent attention to detail, strong analytical skills, and extensive knowledge of U.S. dental insurance plans and billing procedures.



## Primary Responsibilities



### Insurance Claims & Revenue Cycle Management



* Submit dental insurance claims accurately and promptly

* Review and correct claim rejections and denials

* Follow up on outstanding insurance claims

* Communicate with insurance companies regarding claim status

* Track aging insurance accounts receivable

* Appeal denied or underpaid claims when appropriate

* Monitor claim processing and payment timelines



### Insurance Eligibility & Benefits Verification



* Verify patient eligibility and benefits

* Review deductibles, annual maximums, waiting periods, frequencies, and exclusions

* Access insurance carrier portals and websites

* Contact insurance companies directly by phone when necessary

* Document Benefits Breakdown (BOB) accurately in the practice management software



### Daily Accounting & Reconciliation



* Reconcile daily deposits with posted transactions

* Verify insurance payments against Explanation of Benefits (EOBs)

* Verify EFT deposits and insurance checks

* Review adjustment entries and write-offs

* Reconcile patient payments, insurance payments, and deposit records

* Identify discrepancies and investigate variances

* Prepare daily financial reconciliation reports



### Payment Posting



* Post insurance payments accurately

* Post patient payments and adjustments

* Review EOBs and ERA reports

* Verify contractual adjustments

* Ensure account balances remain accurate



### Reporting & Documentation



* Maintain detailed documentation of insurance follow-up activities

* Track outstanding claims and collections

* Generate insurance aging reports

* Monitor revenue cycle performance metrics

* Assist management with financial and insurance reporting



## Qualifications



### Required



* Minimum 3 years of U.S. dental insurance experience

* Minimum 2 years of dental billing or insurance claims experience

* Strong understanding of PPO dental insurance plans

* Experience with payment posting and EOB review

* Experience reconciling deposits and insurance payments

* Excellent English verbal and written communication skills

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy

* Reliable internet connection and professional work environment



### Preferred



* Dental office accounting or bookkeeping experience

* Experience with dental practice management software (Oryx, Dentrix, Open Dental, Eaglesoft, etc.)

* Experience with EFT and ERA processing

* Knowledge of dental coding and claim submission requirements

* Experience with treatment estimates and patient financial arrangements



## Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



* Insurance claims submitted within 24 hours

* Insurance aging maintained below office target

* Daily deposit reconciliation completed accurately

* Payment posting completed within 24 hours of receipt

* Eligibility verification completed before appointments

* Reduction of outstanding insurance balances

* Collection rate improvement



## Schedule



* Full-Time

* 40 Hours per Week

* Ability to overlap with U.S. business hours required



## Compensation



Compensation will be based on experience, dental insurance knowledge, and accounting/reconciliation experience.



Please include:



* Resume

* Dental software experience

* Years of dental insurance experience

* Years of accounting/reconciliation experience

* Expected monthly salary

title: SENIOR CREATIVE LEAD / CREATIVE DIRECTOR — FASHION DTC (ADS, BRAND, CONTENT, UGC)
description:
SENIOR CREATIVE LEAD / CREATIVE DIRECTOR — FASHION DTC (ADS, BRAND, CONTENT, UGC)

Senior, hands-on creatives only · Fashion e-commerce · Remote · Long-term · Leadership role



Please read this entire post before applying. We screen carefully and ignore generic applications. If you follow the instructions at the bottom exactly, you will stand out. If you don't, we'll know you didn't read it.





WHO WE ARE



We operate a growing portfolio of e-commerce fashion brands. We run a real operation — a media buying function, a finance & analytics function, and documented systems for how the work gets done. Our creative is currently lean, and we're ready to invest in it properly. This is a chance to build and lead the creative engine for a scaling brand portfolio.





THE ROLE



We're hiring a Senior Creative Lead to take ownership of our entire creative function across all brands — and to elevate it. You'll be a hands-on maker AND a director: you'll personally produce high-quality creative, set the bar, and lead our existing creative tea
mber while we grow the department around you.



This is a senior leadership seat. You're not taking orders on individual assets — you're owning creative strategy and output across ads, brand, content, and UGC, and making our brands look and feel premium while driving performance.





WHAT YOU'LL OWN



- Performance ad creative (static + video) for Meta, TikTok, and Google — the creative that actually drives sales, working closely with our media buyers

- Brand identity and design systems across our portfolio — keeping each brand consistent, premium, and distinct

- Content and UGC direction — concepting, briefing, and producing scroll-stopping content

- Creative direction and leadership — setting standards, directing our current creative tea
mber, and building the department as it grows

- Turning performance feedback into better creative — you'll get clear data on what's working and iterate



WHAT THIS MEANS DAY TO DAY



- You both MAKE the work (design, edit, produce) and DIRECT it (brief, review, raise the bar)

- You translate brand and performance goals into creative that converts

- You manage and mentor our junior creative, and help us hire as we scale





WHO YOU ARE (HARD REQUIREMENTS)



Do not apply unless ALL of these are true. This is a senior role — we are not training you on the fundamentals of design or creative direction.



- Senior, hands-on creative skill — you personally produce high-quality ad creative, brand design, and content. Strong in the actual tools (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects / Premiere or equivalent, Figma, Canva, etc.)

- Proven FASHION / apparel creative experience — you understand fashion aesthetics, trends, and what makes apparel sell. General graphic design is not the same thing

- Performance creative experience — you've made ad creative for paid social (Meta/TikTok) that was measured on results, not just "looked nice." You understand hooks, angles, and what stops the scroll

- Leadership / direction experience — you've led, directed, or mentored other creatives, or clearly run creative as the senior person on a team

- Range across ads, brand, AND content/UGC — not just one lane

- Strong written English and the communication skills to lead remotely



You are NOT a fit if: you're a junior or mid designer looking to "grow into" a lead role, you only do brand work (no performance ad creative), you've never worked with fashion, you only make static templates, or you've never directed/led other creatives. This is a senior, take-charge seat.





NICE TO HAVE



- Experience building or scaling a creative team or department

- Subscription / membership fashion brand experience

- Comfort directing UGC creators and editing UGC into performance ads

- A point of view on premium / "stealth luxury" fashion aesthetics





HOW WE WORK / WHAT YOU GET



- Real ownership of the creative function across a growing brand portfolio

- A media buying team that gives you clear performance feedback so you know what's working

- A finance & analytics function and documented systems — a real operation, not chaos

- An existing tea
mber to lead from day one, and budget to grow the department

- Long-term, senior, ongoing work with room to build something





HOW TO APPLY (FOLLOW EXACTLY)



Applications that don't follow these steps are rejected automatically. This is the first test of whether you read and follow instructions.



Start your application with this code word: RUNWAY

(This confirms you actually read the post. No code word = no reply.)



Then include all of the following:



1. PORTFOLIO — A link to your portfolio. We want to see fashion ad creative, brand work, and content/UGC. This is the single most important thing — lead with your strongest fashion + performance work.



2. FASHION + PERFORMANCE PROOF — Name 1-2 fashion brands you've made creative for, what you personally produced, and (if you can) a result it drove — e.g. an ad/creative that scaled, beat control, or lifted performance. Real specifics, not "I improved engagement."



3. LEADERSHIP — Describe a time you led, directed, or mentored other creatives, or ran creative as the senior person. We need someone who can take charge, not just execute.



4. THE SCREENING QUESTION — Our media buyer tells you a fashion brand's top-performing ad is fatiguing (CPA rising, frequency climbing). What's your creative process for replacing it with something that performs? (We want to see how you actually think.)



5. LOGISTICS — Your expected monthly rate, weekly availability, and timezone.





A NOTE ON SERIOUSNESS



We run a real, structured operation and we're ready to invest in a senior creative who can elevate everything we make. In return we expect a proven, take-charge creative — not someone hoping to grow into the role. If that's you, show us your best work. If you're mass-applying, please skip this one.

title: HVAC Office Coordinator
description:
# HVAC Administrative Assistant / Office Coordinator-GO HIGH LEVEL EXPERIENCE PREFERRED 



We are seeking an experienced **HVAC Administrative Assistant / Office Coordinator** to help organize and support a growing residential and light commercial AC business.



This role is ideal for someone who has prior HVAC office, dispatch, customer service, or contractor support experience and understands how HVAC service businesses operate. The owner is a skilled technician but needs administrative and operational support to create structure, manage customer communication, track jobs, send invoices, organize records, and keep the business moving smoothly.



## Responsibilities



* Answer incoming calls and respond to customer texts or messages

* Schedule service calls, estimates, installs, and follow-up appointments

* Collect customer information, including name, phone number, address, service issue, and urgency

* Communicate daily job details to the technician in a simple, clear format

* Create and send estimates and invoices

* Track paid and unpaid invoices

* Follow up with customers regarding estimates, payments, completed jobs, and reviews

* Maintain a customer database or job tracking system

* Organize receipts, job notes, parts information, and service records

* Track parts purchased and connect receipts to the correct jobs

* Keep a simple calendar and job schedule updated

* Help create basic business systems for invoicing, scheduling, customer follow-up, and recordkeeping

* Provide professional customer service and help improve the customer experience

* Assist with basic bookkeeping organization by keeping income, expenses, invoices, and receipts organized for tax preparation



## Required Experience



* Prior experience working with an HVAC company, contractor, service company, or home services business

* Understanding of HVAC service calls, repairs, installs, estimates, parts, and customer scheduling

* Experience creating invoices and estimates

* Strong phone, text, and customer service skills

* Comfortable using basic business tools such as Google Calendar, Gmail, QuickBooks, Square, Housecall Pro, Jobber, Wave, or similar systems

* Highly organized and detail-oriented

* Able to work independently and follow up without being micromanaged

* Patient and comfortable supporting a business owner who is not tech-savvy

* Able to take verbal notes, text messages, photos, and receipts and turn them into organized records



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is organized, reliable, and understands that this role is about bringing structure to a business that has been operating without formal systems. You must be comfortable helping build simple processes from the ground up.



This is not just a receptionist role. This person will help create order around:



* Scheduling

* Customer communication

* Estimates

* Invoicing

* Payment tracking

* Job records

* Receipts

* Follow-up

* Basic office operations



## Important Note



The business owner is not computer-savvy, so this role requires someone who can serve as the technology and office bridge. The owner will provide job details through phone calls, text messages, voice notes, photos, and receipts. The assistant must be able to take that information and organize it into a professional system.



## Must-Have Skills



* HVAC office or dispatch experience

* Strong organization

* Customer service

* Scheduling

* Invoicing

* Follow-up

* Basic computer skills

* Clear communication

* Reliability

* Ability to create simple systems



## Preferred Tools Experience



Experience with any of the following is helpful:

GO HIGH LEVEL 



* QuickBooks

* Square

* Google Calendar

* Google Drive

* Gmail

* Housecall Pro

* Jobber

* Wave

* Excel or Google Sheets



## Schedule



Part-time to start, with the opportunity to grow as the business becomes more structured.



## Compensation



$4 hour



## How to Apply



Please respond with the word HVAC first then:



1. Your prior HVAC or contractor office experience

2. The systems or tools you have used for scheduling, invoicing, or customer tracking

3. A brief explanation of how you would help organize a business that currently has no formal office systems

You’ll help with warm leads interested in our cleaning services, cleaner applicant follow-up, social media/ad creative support, and the daily growth tasks that keep people from falling through the cracks.



This role is ideal for someone who thrives in sales conversations, knows how to build rapport quickly, doesn’t shy away from tough questions or hesitations from prospects, and can stay organized across multiple follow-up lanes.



Key responsibilities



Sales / lead follow-up

s/messages, document collection, and basic administrative tasks.

mbers.

- Comfortable talking to U.S. customers and building rapport quickly.

- Proven ability to overcome objections and move people toward a decision.

title: Customer Service Representative (Entry-Level) — No Experience Needed, Permanent Work-From-Home
description:
Join Helpfully



Helpfully is a US-based customer operations company that supports some of the fastest-growing eCommerce brands online. When a customer needs help, our team is the voice they trust — and we take that seriously.



We're growing, and we're looking for sharp, dependable people who genuinely enjoy helping others and communicate with confidence in English — even if you've never worked in customer service before. If you want a stable, long-term work-from-home role with a company that invests in its people and gives you real tools to do great work, you're in the right place.



This isn't a fly-by-night gig. Our clients stay with us for years, our team is global and tight-knit, and the people who do great work here grow with us as we scale.



What you'll do



As a Customer Service Representative, you'll be the front line for our clients' customers — handling questions, solving problems, and making sure every person you talk to walks away taken care of. Day to day, that looks like:

- Helping customers by phone — clearly, warmly, and professionally

- Digging into the details to actually solve the problem, not just close the ticket

- Navigating our tools to find answers and take action on customer accounts

- Keeping accurate notes so the whole team stays in sync

- Sharing what you learn and giving feedback that makes the team better



Why you'll love working here



1. 100% permanent work-from-home. No commute, no traffic, no relocating — work from anywhere in the Philippines with a reliable connection.

2. A company that's actually growing. We're scaling, which means real opportunities to take on more and move up for people who perform.

3. Tools that don't get in your way. We built our own platform — phone system, ticketing, dashboards, and more — so you spend your time helping customers, not fighting clunky software.

4. Stable, long-term accounts. Our clients stick with us for years, which means steady work and the chance to truly master your accounts.

5. A real team behind you. You won't be left to figure things out alone. We share knowledge, support each other, and celebrate the wins together.

6. Hands on training. No experience needed — we'll teach you everything and set you up to succeed from day one.



Who we're looking for

You'll thrive here if you:



1. Speak and write English fluently and confidently. This is the single most important thing. Our customers need to understand you easily, and you need to understand them — clear, professional, natural English is a must.

2. No customer service experience required — we'll train you from day one. Any customer-facing experience (retail, food service, hospitality, virtual assistant, sales) is a nice plus, but it's not required.

3. Are eager to learn and coachable — you take feedback well and want to get better every day.

4. Are comfortable with technology and quick to pick up new tools.

5. Stay calm, patient, and friendly — you genuinely enjoy helping people, even when they're frustrated.

6. Phone/voice experience is a big plus. If you've handled live calls before, we really want to hear from you.

7. Type at least 30 WPM.

8. Are self-motivated and productive working independently from home.

9. Are flexible on scheduling — shifts can vary and may include evenings, weekends, or holidays depending on the account.



What you'll need (home office setup) To work from home with us, you'll need:

- A desktop or laptop running Windows 10 or higher, with 8GB+ RAM and an Intel i3 processor or better, free of malware and viruses

- A noise-cancelling USB headset, plus a mouse and keyboard

- A wired internet connection with at least 20 Mbps download / 30 Mbps upload

- A backup internet connection for when your main one goes down

- A quiet, private, and secure workspace free from background noise



Ready to apply?



We'd love to hear from you. When you apply, don't just send a resume — tell us a little about yourself:



In a few sentences (in English), tell us why you'd be great at helping people — and a time you helped someone solve a problem. Any situation counts; it doesn't have to be a job. Mention any phone or voice support experience you have.



Bonus: include a short 30–60 second voice recording introducing yourself, so we can hear your spoken English.



If you're reliable, great with people, and ready to do work you can be proud of — apply now. We're excited to meet you.

title: Senior Media Buyer — Fashion DTC (Meta, TikTok & Google)
description:
SENIOR MEDIA BUYER — FASHION DTC (META, TIKTOK & GOOGLE)

Experienced buyers only · Fashion e-commerce brands · Remote · Long-term



Please read this entire post before applying. We screen carefully and ignore generic applications. If you follow the instructions at the bottom exactly, you will stand out. If you don't, we'll know you didn't read it.





WHO WE ARE



We operate a growing portfolio of e-commerce fashion brands. We run a real operation: a dedicated creative team, a finance & analytics function that sets clear acquisition targets, and a documented system for how media buying is run here. You'd be joining an established structure, not building one from scratch.





THE ROLE



We're hiring an experienced media buyer to take several fashion brands off our plate and scale them profitably. You'll be handed an ad account, introduced to the creative designer you'll work with, given a clear NCPA (New Customer Cost Per Acquisition) target per brand from our finance team, and our internal Media Buyer Operating Manual. From there, you run it.



Your job is simple to state and hard to do well: hit the NCPA target on every brand you run, and scale spend profitably. You'll have full autonomy to make daily scale/cut/test decisions within our framework — we don't micromanage buyers who deliver.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Plan, launch, and manage paid campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and Google for multiple fashion brands

- Hit and protect the NCPA target finance sets for each brand — scaling spend while staying profitable on new-customer acquisition

- Work directly with your assigned creative designer: request, brief, and test new creatives and angles

- Make daily scale / hold / cut / test decisions using our decision framework

- Manage budgets, pacing, audiences, and creative testing across platforms

- Report performance weekly, with a deeper monthly review





WHO YOU ARE (HARD REQUIREMENTS)



Do not apply unless ALL of these are true. We are not training anyone on the fundamentals — you must already be able to do this work on day one.



- Proven, hands-on experience running Meta, TikTok, AND Google ads — not one or two of them, all three

- Specific experience with FASHION / apparel e-commerce brands. You understand fashion buyers, seasonality, creative trends, and how fashion catalogs convert. General e-comm or lead-gen experience is not the same thing

- You've owned acquisition to a CPA / CAC / ROAS target before and can speak to real numbers you hit and how

- You can work independently with full autonomy — follow a documented system, make your own daily decisions, and deliver results without hand-holding

- Strong written English for clear remote communication and reporting



You are NOT a fit if: you're a generalist VA who "also does ads," you've only run one platform, you've never worked with fashion brands, you need to be taught how campaigns work, or you're looking for a short-term gig. This is a serious, long-term seat.





NICE TO HAVE



- Experience with subscription / membership fashion models

- Comfort with Advantage+ / catalog ads and CAPI setup

- Experience managing multiple brands or ad accounts at once





HOW WE WORK / WHAT YOU GET



- Clear NCPA targets per brand from a dedicated finance & analytics function — you're never guessing what "profitable" means

- A dedicated creative designer to brief and request from

- A documented Media Buyer Operating Manual so expectations and decision rules are explicit from day one

- Full autonomy to run your brands within the framework

- Long-term, ongoing work with a growing brand portfolio





HOW TO APPLY (FOLLOW EXACTLY)



Applications that don't follow these steps are rejected automatically. This is the first test of whether you read and follow instructions, which is the job.



Start your application with this code word: PORTFOLIO

(This confirms you actually read the post. No code word = no reply.)



Then include all of the following:



1. PLATFORMS — Confirm which of Meta, TikTok, and Google you've personally run, and for how long on each.



2. FASHION PROOF — Name 1-2 fashion / apparel brands you've run ads for, what your role was, and specifically a result you drove (e.g. "scaled X brand from $Y to $Z/day at a $___ CPA"). Real numbers, not "I improved performance."



3. SCREENING QUESTION — If I gave you a fashion brand with a target NCPA (new customer cost per acquisition) of $40, and an ad set had spent $120 with 1 purchase, what would you do and why? (We want to see how you actually think.)



4. LOGISTICS — Your expected monthly rate, your weekly availability, and your timezone.



5. PROOF — A link to a portfolio, case studies, screenshots of past account performance, or anything that proves the above. Claims without proof carry little weight.





A NOTE ON SERIOUSNESS



We run a real, structured operation and we invest in the people who join it. In return we expect proven operators who take the work seriously. If that's you, we'd love to see your application. If you're mass-applying, please skip this one.

/wholesale

title: Order Operations Specialist (Remote - Excellent English!)
description:
About the role



We run a social engagement and brand-visibility service. Most of our order volume is delivered automatically by our system, but a steady stream of orders is fulfilled by hand, and every customer message needs a fast, clear, human reply. Right now those two things slip: customers wait days for answers and often cannot tell whether their order was actually delivered. You will own that gap end to end.



This is a detail-and-follow-through job, not a creative one. If you like clearing a queue to zero and leaving customers with a clear answer, you will do well here.



What you will do



- Answer customers quickly and clearly (the core of the job). Most questions are "when will this be delivered?", "it says delivered but I don't see it," and "can you redo or change this?" You will open the order, confirm what happened, reply with a proof link, set expectations, and close the loop. Today many of these go unanswered and turn into refund requests. Your job is to make sure that stops.

- Fulfill the orders we do not automate. For each by-hand order, you do the work and record it: 
ments, Quora answers and upvotes, X comments, YouTube comments, Threads followers and likes, ProductHunt upvotes, AI and community brand mentions, and blog citations. You post or deliver the engagement, paste the proof link, and mark each unit delivered as it goes live (for example, an order of 15 brand mentions gets updated one by one as each is posted).

- Keep status and proof accurate. Every active order should show the right status with a link or screenshot proving it is real. The single biggest complaint we get is "it shows delivered but I cannot find it." You make that complaint disappear.

- Resolve issues. When something is removed, shadowbanned, or a count drops, re-deliver it or escalate. Process refunds or store credit when it is the right call. Handle custom comment text and edit requests.

- Review and flag. Screen the content customers ask us to post, and flag anything inappropriate, harmful, or that you cannot resolve, rather than guessing.

- What you will not do: the automated deliveries themselves (Reddit upvotes, downvotes, and comments are handled by our system). You still answer the customer messages about those orders and resolve problems, but you do not deliver them.



You should have

- Excellent written English. You will be writing to customers all day, often when they are frustrated.

- Real attention to detail and follow-through. Orders have many small units, and each one needs proof.

- Ownership. We need someone who clears the queue every day and does not let it pile up.

- Comfort with web dashboards and the major social platforms (Reddit, LinkedIn, X, Quora, YouTube, Threads, ProductHunt).

- Discretion and professionalism. You will see customer details and order content.



Nice to have

- Customer support or virtual assistant experience.

- Familiarity with social media growth or engagement services.



To apply

Start your message with the word SIGNAL so we know you read this all the way through. In a few sentences, tell us about a time a customer was upset with you and exactly how you turned it around.

title: Auto Transport Operations Coordinator (Remote – Philippines)

Pay: $3–$4 USD/hour base + commission per booked load (structure discussed during interview) Employment Type: Full-time / Contract About the Role



TrueTruck Auto Transport is a US-based auto transport brokerage. We connect customers who need to ship vehicles with the carriers who move them, and we built this company on a simple idea: be honest with customers, every single time. That means accurate quotes, real timelines, and no games. It's how we want every conversation to sound.



We're looking for a sharp, motivated coordinator to handle the day-to-day communication that keeps shipments moving — talking and texting with customers, working leads, negotiating with carriers, and posting loads on the major dispatch boards. 



This is a hands-on operations role where you'll wear several hats and have a direct impact on whether a load gets booked, dispatched, and delivered cleanly.



You don't need prior auto transport experience. We'll train you on everything. What we need is excellent English, quick thinking, and someone who can hold their own on the phone and over text.



What You'll Do



- Respond to inbound customer leads via phone and text — quote shipments, explain the process, and book the job

- Handle a high volume of text message conversations with customers, leads, carriers, and drivers throughout the day

- Cold call leads when other work is quiet (this is a steady part of the role, not the main focus, but it matters)

- Communicate with existing customers — provide updates, answer questions, handle issues professionally

- Post loads on Super Dispatch and Central Dispatch

- Negotiate rates with carriers and dispatchers to get loads moved at the right price

- Verify carrier insurance and authority before dispatching

- Coordinate with carriers and drivers throughout pickup and delivery — confirm details, troubleshoot delays, keep everyone on the same page

- Keep our internal CRM up to date with accurate notes on every customer, lead, and load

- Flag problems early — a late driver, a customer concern, a carrier that won't pick up the phone



What We're Looking For

- This role requires real-time thinking on the phone and clear, professional writing over text. You'll be talking to US customers who want clear answers, texting back and forth with leads who are comparing quotes and negotiating with carriers who push hard on rates. You need to:

 - Listen carefully, respond clearly, and not get rattled

 - Write quick, professional text messages with correct grammar and a natural American tone

 - Stay honest with customers even when it's not what they want to hear — it's how we operate

 - Push back politely but firmly when a carrier's rate doesn't work

 - Juggle multiple shipments and text threads at different stages without dropping the ball



Requirements



- Excellent written and spoken English — near-native fluency, minimal accent, clean writing

- Able to think and respond on your feet during live phone calls

- Fast, accurate typing — a lot of this job is texting

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet work environment

- Comfortable on the phone — this is a phone-heavy and text-heavy role

- Comfortable using basic computer tools:
, messaging apps, CRM software

- Available Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM US Eastern Time, consistently

- Responsive during your shift



Preferred (Not Required)

- Prior experience in auto transport, logistics, freight brokerage, or dispatch

- Sales, cold calling, or call center experience

- Customer service experience with US customers

- Familiarity with Super Dispatch, Central Dispatch, or any TMS/CRM software



We provide the phone system, software access, and training. You bring the work ethic and the English.



What We Offer

- Full-time, consistent hours with a stable US-based company

- Base pay plus commission on every load you book — the more you close, the more you earn

- Real training on the auto transport industry, not just a script

- Direct communication with a small team — you'll know who you're working with

- Long-term role for the right person



To Apply

Applications without a personal message will not be considered.

title: Inbox Manager & Appointment Setter (Warm Leads, No Cold Calling)
description:
About the role



We run a done-for-you course creation and marketing agency for coaches and consultants. Our marketing brings in a steady flow of warm, pre-qualified leads who reply to our outreach, and we need someone dependable to own that inbox. You'll respond quickly, and turn good conversations into booked calls on our sales team's calendar.



This is not a cold-calling role. Every lead you speak to has already engaged with us. Your job is to turn that interest into booked calls.



What you'll do





Watch a shared inbox and reply to incoming lead messages within minutes

Use our AI-assisted drafting system to reply fast. You review the draft, refine it, and send. When the draft isn't good enough, you write a better one. The tool makes you faster, it does not replace you.

Call leads who have opted in, to confirm them and book them onto a sales call

Qualify every lead against a clear checklist before booking

Keep our CRM (Close) accurate and up to date





This role is for you if





Your written English is excellent. Clear, natural, and professional. Most of this role is writing.

Your spoken English is confident and natural, with a friendly, easy-to-understand phone presence. You'll be on calls every day, so this is essential.

You have real experience in appointment setting, inside sales, SDR work, or phone-based customer service

You can follow a proven system closely, and still think on your feet when a call goes off-script

You have reliable high-speed internet, plus a backup for when the power or connection drops. Our whole promise to leads is a fast reply, so this genuinely matters.

You want a stable, long-term role rather than a short gig. We invest in our people and want someone who will grow with us.





Hours



Full-time, 10 hours a day, Monday to Friday, covering 2pm to 12am UK. So In the Philippines this is a night-shift role.



Compensation





Base: $600 / month

Plus $2 for every qualified call booked from the inbox

Plus $4 for every qualified call booked from a warm dial

On-target earnings around $1,100 to $1,400 / month

Genuinely uncapped. The more qualified calls you book, the more you earn, and strong performers go well above target.

Paid reliably, on time, every month





A qualified booking means the lead has opted in and confirmed a specific time.



Why this seat is worth taking





Warm leads only. No cold calling and no chasing dead lists.

AI tools that make you faster instead of replacing you

Clear targets, transparent pay, and real upside

A well-run team that pays on time and keeps its people for the long term





How to apply:



Please read carefully. Applications that skip these steps will not be reviewed.





Record a short voice note or Loom video, 1 to 2 minutes. Introduce yourself and your relevant experience. YOU MUST START YOUR LOOM WITH THE WORD "PUMPKIN". Then role-play this 
nt: a lead has replied "I'm interested but really busy right now," and you are re-engaging them on a call. Show us how you would handle it.

Tell us your internet speed, and what your backup plan is if the power or internet goes down.

Use this exact subject line: Warm Inbox - [Your First Name] - Pumpkin





We read every application that follows these three steps.
