title: Registered Nurse (RN) – Home Health Quality Assurance (QA)
description:
Position Summary



The Home Health Quality Assurance (QA) Registered Nurse is responsible for reviewing and auditing patient clinical records to ensure compliance with agency policies, payer requirements, and applicable regulations. The QA RN ensures the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of documentation throughout the patient's episode of care while supporting high-quality patient care and documentation standards.



Essential Duties and Responsibilities



Clinical Record Review and Audit



 • Review patient charts for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with agency standards.

 • Verify that physician orders are present, signed, dated, and consistent with the patient's plan of care and clinical documentation.

 • Ensure physician orders align with nursing, therapy, and interdisciplinary documentation.

 • Review patient diagnoses for accuracy, appropriateness, and consistency throughout the medical record.

 • Validate that primary and secondary diagnoses support the services provided and documented.



Documentation Quality Assurance



 • Review and verify required documentation, including:

  ? History and Physical (H&P)

  ? Plan of Care (POC)

  ? Medication profiles

  ? Admission documentation

  ? Visit notes

  ? Discharge summaries

 • Ensure all documentation is complete, accurate, and meets agency and payer requirements.

 • Identify missing, inconsistent, or incomplete documentation and communicate deficiencies to clinicians for correction.



Quality Monitoring



 • Monitor compliance with applicable home health regulations, payer requirements, and agency policies.

 • Review orders, visit notes, and care plans for adherence to home health regulations and agency policies.

 • Ensure timely completion of documentation and physician signatures.

 • Identify trends, documentation deficiencies, and opportunities for process improvement.

 • Collaborate with clinical managers and interdisciplinary tea
mbers to improve documentation quality and compliance.



Additional Responsibilities



 • Track and follow up on outstanding physician orders and documentation corrections.

 • Maintain confidentiality and security of patient health information in accordance with HIPAA regulations.

 • Support agency readiness for surveys, audits, and accreditation reviews.

 • Assist with the implementation of agency policies and quality initiatives as assigned.



Qualifications



 • Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in good standing.

 • Minimum of 2 years of home health nursing experience preferred.

 • Previous Quality Assurance, clinical auditing, or chart review experience preferred.

 • Knowledge of home health regulations, documentation standards, and payer requirements.

 • Proficiency in electronic medical records (EMR) systems. Experience using Data Soft Logic (DSL) preferred.

 • Strong attention to detail, critical thinking, organizational, and communication skills.

title: Projects & Operations Manager (Contractor)
description:
PHP 150 to PHP 175 per Hour



Asana, Freshsales CRM and Automation

Remote contractor engagement | Open to Philippines-based applicants | Australian client



We run three connected businesses out of Australia and there are a lot of moving parts. We need one organised, switched-on person to own the systems behind all of it so nothing slips through the cracks.

If you genuinely enjoy taking a messy pile of
s, ideas, and half-finished tasks and turning it into a clean tracked project that actually gets finished, you are going to like this role.

This is a contractor engagement, not a job. You manage your own hours, equipment, invoicing, and tax. But we are looking for someone for the long run, not a one-off.

Who you would be working with

The businesses span accommodation, tourism, events, podcasting, and digital marketing:



iBooked.Online builds websites and book-direct marketing strategies for accommodation businesses.

The Accommodation Show is a weekly podcast featuring leaders from across the short-term rental and accommodation industry.

STRIVE Conference is an industry event series with speakers, sponsors, partners, and attendees, currently expanding across APAC.

On top of those there is a steady stream of client work, marketing, partnerships, and content projects.

What you would actually do

Your job is to make sure work gets tracked, people get followed up, deadlines get hit, and information lives in the right place instead of scattered across our inboxes. In practice that breaks down into a few areas.

Run our projects in Asana

Asana is where delivery happens. You would build and maintain clear projects for events, podcast production, website work, marketing, and internal jobs. That means turning conversations,
s, and meeting notes into real tasks with owners, due dates, and priorities. You would spot overdue tasks and missing assets before they become problems, keep the boards genuinely useful rather than cluttered, and send us a regular summary of what is done, what is coming up, and what is stuck.

Run our pipeline in Freshsales CRM

Freshsales is where relationships and follow-ups
 sponsors, partners, leads, speakers, suppliers. You would keep records accurate, track next actions and pipeline stages, and make sure no opportunity dies because someone forgot to follow up. We also want your help building simple CRM processes and sensible automations rather than just data entry.

Coordinate the STRIVE conferences

Events are where the most balls are in the air. You would manage speaker and sponsor deliverables, chase bios, headshots, presentation files, logos, contracted inclusions, ticket allocations, invoices, and marketing deadlines, and keep the operational checklists and timelines current.

Keep the podcast and content moving

You would manage the workflow for guests, recordings, transcripts, show notes, and promo, so every episode moves smoothly from booking to launch without us having to remember what stage it is at.

Coordinate website and marketing projects

You would track client content, images, approvals, and outstanding actions, and coordinate between clients, designers, developers, and marketing contractors so projects stay on schedule.

Improve how we work

When you spot a process we keep doing manually, we want you to say so and fix it. Templates, checklists, SOPs, and practical automations between Freshsales, Asana, and Google Workspace. You do not need to be a developer. You do need to look at a repetitive task and think "this should be automated."

The systems you would use



Asana for project and task delivery

Freshsales CRM for contacts, pipelines, and follow-ups

Automation and AI: Zapier or Make, Google Workspace, Asana rules and templates, Freshsales workflows, and AI tools like ChatGPT for summaries, drafts, and documentation

Who we are looking for

The right person:



Has real experience in project management, operations, or delivery coordination

Is strong in Asana, or a very similar project management tool

Has CRM experience, ideally Freshsales or Freshworks, but HubSpot, Pipedrive, or similar is fine

Writes excellent, professional English

Can run their own deliverables and deadlines without being chased

Goes looking for missing information, overdue tasks, and gaps instead of waiting to be told

Is comfortable following up external people directly

Understands the difference between recording a task and actually driving it to done

You do not have to be an expert in both Asana and Freshsales today. The ideal candidate is genuinely strong in one, comfortable with pipeline-style CRM work, and quick to learn the other and build sensible workflows between the two.

Bonus points for

Experience with any of these will stand out: Freshsales setup and automation, advanced Asana (rules, dashboards, reporting), Zapier or Make, event or conference coordination, sponsor and partnership management, podcast production, website agency or digital marketing project management, SOP documentation, AI-assisted workflows, and working with Australian, New Zealand, UK, or US clients.

Hours and availability

This is flexible and based on what is active. Expect roughly 15 to 20 hours per week to start, rising and falling with projects and the conference calendar.

No fixed daily hours, but you will need to attend the occasional meeting, stay responsive around deadlines, and have some practical overlap with Melbourne, Australia time. You are free to work with other clients as long as there is no conflict of interest.

Rate

Hourly contractor rate in PHP, invoiced for approved hours worked.

Indicative range: PHP 150 to PHP 175 per hour, depending on your experience, ability to own projects, CRM skills, and practical automation capability. Demonstrated Freshsales and Asana experience puts you toward the top of that range.

Confidentiality

You would handle business, sponsor, partner, and client information, content calendars, and account access. You will need to sign a contractor agreement covering confidentiality, data protection, account security, intellectual property, and conflicts of interest. Any access you are given is used only for agreed work and kept secure.





How to apply: (Read this section)



We are running an industry conference involving 25 speakers, 10 sponsors, potential partners and sales opportunities, presentation files, speaker photos and bios, sponsor logos and contracted inclusions, ticket allocations, invoices, marketing deadlines, and several external contractors.

Tell us how you would organise this using Asana and Freshsales. Cover:



What you would track in Asana

What you would track in Freshsales

How you would manage deadlines and missing information

How you would track sponsors and partner opportunities

What you would automate

What you would report to us each week



We want a practical answer from real thinking and experience, not a generic AI-written one. Applications that skip this question may not be read.





Subject line

Use this exact subject line:

Independent Contractor Application | Asana + Freshsales | [Your Name]

description:

[Join DongYang Engineering and Build Global Business Together with Filipino Talent]

- DongYang Engineering (DYE) is an engineering-based global trading company located in Ulsan, Korea, with approximately 30 employees.

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

- In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea.

- Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea
mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- DYE also plans to expand its overseas sales and global operations team with a focus on Filipino talent. Therefore, this position offers future opportunities to grow into a team leader or management role.



[About the Position]

- We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Inquiry / Quotation ERP Data Assistant.(Entry~Experienced Level)

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.

youtu.be/zCExthh9pzc?si=EkDCs7pqN6WylsWP

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.

1. Eligible Career Level

- This position is open to both entry-level/junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Entry-level or junior candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to help them adapt to our internal systems, work process, and operational standards.



Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



2. Payment Terms

- Payment Term: Monthly basis

- Probationary Period: 6 months



3. Salary Guideline for Entry-Level and Junior Candidates

- For entry-level candidates or candidates with limited related experience, the probationary salary will follow the company’s internal guideline below.

- Months 0–3: USD 280/month

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month

- Subject to satisfactory performance evaluation after the first 3 months.

The probationary period may be shortened if the employee demonstrates fast work adaptation and receives an excellent evaluation. This has occurred in multiple past cases.



4. Salary Guideline for Experienced Candidates

- Candidates with 3 or more years of relevant practical experience may apply as experienced candidates.

- For experienced candidates, the contracted monthly salary may be considered up to USD 450/month, depending on the candidate’s work experience, practical capability, technical understanding, communication skills, and overall fit for the position.

- Experienced candidates will also be subject to a 6-month probationary period. During the probationary period, salary will be paid according to the following structure.

- Months 0–3: 90% of the contracted monthly salary

- Months 4–6: 100% of the contracted monthly salary

- For example, if the final contracted monthly salary is set at USD 450/month, the employee will receive USD 405/month during Months 0–3 and USD 450/month during Months 4–6.

- The final contracted monthly salary will be determined after reviewing the candidate’s relevant experience, job understanding, work capability, sense of responsibility, communication skills, and overall fit with the company’s internal standards.



[After Regularization]

- Annual contract renewal is standard after regularization.

- Salary adjustments may be made based on performance, teamwork, and overall evaluation.

- If overall performance, including work capability, teamwork, reliability, and internal evaluations, is considered outstanding, - salary increases may be granted within a shorter period. This has occurred in multiple past cases.

- Exceptional performance may also lead to early promotions or salary increases prior to the annual review.



[Perks & Benefits]

- 13th Month Salary provided

- 10 additional paid leave days upon regularization

- Additional incentives may be provided during high-performance business periods or when performance is excellent.

- Incentives are reviewed based on work attitude, responsibility, consistency, and overall contribution.

3. Paid Holidays

- January 1st, New Year’s Day, and Christmas Day are paid holidays.

- This applies to both probationary and regular employees.

4. Long Service Incentive Program

- 1 Year Service: PHP 17,000

- 3 Year Service: PHP 22,500

- 5 Year Service: PHP 28,000



[How To Apply for the job]

Just Fill out 10 Simple Questions through Google Form






Interview via google meet will be conducted after first screening and candidates will be notifed to their
s or

This position plays an important role in accurately organizing overseas buyer inquiries and domestic supplier quotations for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products in the ERP system.



If you have a background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field, and you can handle documents and data carefully, you can successfully adapt to this role with DYE’s training and support.



As DYE plans to expand its global team with a focus on Filipino talent, this position offers the opportunity to grow into a larger role in the future.

title: GRAPHIC DESIGNER (META STATIC ADS)
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a fast, iterative, and data-driven Graphic Designer to join our e-commerce apparel team. Your primary focus will be designing high-converting static image ads for Meta 
 & Instagram).



This is a high-volume, high-execution role. You won’t be staring at a blank canvas for hours waiting for inspiration; instead, you will be executing on proven frameworks, scaling winning concepts, and rapidly producing creative variations. You must be comfortable producing up to 30 assets per day (including 3 distinct variations per concept) plus handling standard revisions.



If you thrive in a fast-paced DTC environment, understand what makes people stop scrolling, and can maintain quality at speed, this role is for you.



Key Responsibilities

High-Volume Creative Output: Design and deliver up to 30 Meta image ad assets per day based on creative briefs, current trends, and winning account data.



Iterative Design: Create 3 distinct variations for each core concept (e.g., testing different hooks, backgrounds, colorways, or product layouts) to optimize for Meta’s ad auction.



Speed & Systemization: Build and maintain an efficient template system (in Photoshop, Figma, or Illustrator) to ensure rapid turnaround times without sacrificing visual polish.



Ad Formats: Create assets across multiple placements, primarily focusing on Square (1:1) and Stories/Reels (9:16) formats.



Collaboration & Revisions: Work closely with our media buying and creative strategy team to implement quick revisions based on performance data and brand guidelines.



What We Are Looking For

DTC/E-commerce Experience: Minimum 1–2 years of experience designing specifically for paid social (Meta/TikTok), preferably within the clothing, fashion, or apparel space.



Speed and Efficiency: A proven ability to manage high-volume daily deliverables. You know how to use smart objects, templates, and batch workflows to move fast.



Direct Response Knowledge: You understand why an ad converts. You know how to make text readable on mobile, emphasize the product, and place call-to-actions effectively.



Apparel-Specific Eye: Clean typography, sharp color correction, and an understanding of how to make fabrics and fits look premium in a split second.



Software Mastery: Expert proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, or Figma.

Execution-Focused: This role requires a high volume of daily outputs. We value speed, organizational skills, and a "test-and-learn" mindset over precious, slow design processes.



Feedback-Driven: You view ad performance data and creative revisions as guideposts, not personal criticism. If a variation fails, we iterate; if it wins, we scale it.
